whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Z cafe Rooftop Restaurant and party Zone,

I noticed your rooftop restaurant has solid 4.3★ reviews in Alamganj, Patna, but currently relies on third-party aggregator links instead of a dedicated mobile ordering and party booking page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct table booking, rooftop party package inquiry, aur food menu showcase integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/zcafe

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi Z cafe Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Z cafe Rooftop Restaurant and party Zone) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? 

[If checked]: Great! We tailored it specifically with direct table reservation, rooftop party inquiries, and a mobile-first food menu showcase for Alamganj. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? 
[If not checked]: No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback. 
Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
